{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Double-check the exact spelling and case of 'arm' and 'severity' values
print('Unique arms:', df['arm'].unique())
print('Unique severities:', df['severity'].unique())

# Check if there are any rows where arm is 'CONTROL' and severity is 'MODERATE'
check = df[(df['arm'] == 'CONTROL') & (df['severity'] == 'MODERATE')]
print('\nRows matching CONTROL and MODERATE:', len(check))
print(check.head())"}
